items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: the only ones that they won, battle that they won, was Little Big Horn, when they wiped out General Custer, you know.

ctx.x: Well, that's true, but when you say 'history,' you mean past history.

Oh, yeah, past history. I like European history. I didn't care too much for American history because they never -- the only American is the Indian and you very seldom read anything about the Indian in history, no more than being inhuman. And if you see all the movies, they would take ten white soldiers, they would wipe out 10,000 Indians, you know? They were always losing. And the only ones that they won, battle that they won, was Little Big Horn, when they wiped out General Custer, you know. They had to make…
Yeah, they always are ridiculous, you know.
